cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务台的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and at 14:00 GMT on Wednesday, the 9th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。现在是格林尼治时间9月9日星期三14点，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: In one of the starkest warnings yet about AI, a leading researcher at Anthropic says
cues.zh: 在迄今最严厉的人工智能警告之一中，Anthropic的一名资深研究员表示，

cues.en: there is a greater than 10% chance the technology could wipe out humanity.
cues.zh: 这项技术彻底毁灭人类的概率超过10%。

cues.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham says Britain must stand against injustice after imposing sanctions over Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
cues.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，英国在因被占领的约旦河西岸以色列定居点实施制裁后，必须反对不公。

cues.en: Our reporter investigates a spike in murders of women that's being called a femicide crisis in the Central African state of Cameroon.
cues.zh: 本台记者调查中非国家喀麦隆女性谋杀案激增的情况，这被称为女性杀戮危机。

cues.en: Also in this podcast... I just wanted to prove that Afghan women can do different things.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将播出……我只是想证明，阿富汗女性也能做不同的事情。

cues.en: Afghan women are not powerless, as we live in the darkest part of the history.
cues.zh: 阿富汗女性并非无能为力，尽管我们生活在历史上最黑暗的时期。

cues.en: An Afghan woman climbs Everest in a world first to inspire women and girls.
cues.zh: 一名阿富汗女性首次登上珠穆朗玛峰，以激励女性和女孩。

cues.en: There's a greater than 10% chance AI could kill us all by the end of the decade.
cues.zh: 在本十年结束前，人工智能杀死我们所有人的概率超过10%。

cues.en: That's the stark warning from a manager at the artificial intelligence company Anthropic.
cues.zh: 这是人工智能公司Anthropic一名经理发出的严厉警告。

cues.en: Along with a colleague who has now resigned, they've said on social media they're worried that the technology could threaten humanity.
cues.zh: 他和一名如今已经辞职的同事在社交媒体上表示，他们担心这项技术可能威胁人类。

cues.en: Our technology reporter Chris Vallance told me more about this development.
cues.zh: 本台科技记者克里斯·瓦兰斯向我进一步介绍了这一进展。

cues.en: This is a pretty extraordinary exchange that took place on a social media platform, X.
cues.zh: 这是一次相当不同寻常的交流，发生在社交媒体平台X上。

cues.en: I should preface this by saying that we need to remember that human beings have been pretty good at bringing themselves to threats, to drive themselves out of existence
cues.zh: 我先说明一点：我们必须记住，人类一直很擅长把自身置于威胁之中，把自己推向灭绝，

cues.en: without the help of artificial intelligence.
cues.zh: 即使没有人工智能的帮助。

cues.en: But this was Evan Hubinger, the alignment science lead at Anthropic.
cues.zh: 但这番话来自Anthropic的对齐科学负责人埃文·胡宾格。

cues.en: Now, alignment science is essentially making sure that these AI models do what you expect them to do.
cues.zh: 所谓对齐科学，本质上就是确保这些人工智能模型按你的预期运行。

cues.en: And he was responding on X to a post by another researcher
cues.zh: 他当时是在X上回应另一名研究员的一则帖子，

cues.en: who US reports say had worked at OpenAI and Anthropic for a couple of years.
cues.zh: 美国媒体报道称，这名研究员曾在OpenAI和Anthropic工作过几年。

cues.en: And that researcher had posted, "The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade."
cues.zh: 这名研究员发帖说：“开发人工智能的人真心相信，在本十年结束前，它可能杀死我们所有人。”

cues.en: And Evan, the Anthropic alignment science lead, says he agrees that that was right.
cues.zh: Anthropic对齐科学负责人埃文表示，他同意这种说法是对的。

cues.en: And he said, "We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans," exclamation point.
cues.zh: 他还说：“我们确实真心相信人工智能可能杀死所有人。”感叹号。

cues.en: I personally think it's a greater than 10% chance within the next decade.
cues.zh: 我个人认为，未来十年内这种可能性超过10%。

cues.en: Now, we've had warnings before, but this is expressed in very blunt language.
cues.zh: 我们以前也听到过警告，但这次的说法非常直白。

cues.en: As you say, we've had warnings before, a lot of warnings actually, from within the AI community.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，我们以前听到过警告，实际上是来自人工智能界的大量警告。

cues.en: Are the rest of us maybe a bit naive about the dangers this technology poses?
cues.zh: 我们其他人是否可能对这项技术带来的危险有些天真？

cues.en: Well, I kind of think there are two things here we can say.
cues.zh: 我觉得这里有两点可以说。

cues.en: Certainly, when we look at the recent incidents where autonomous agents from these companies have gone on unasked-for hacking sprees,
cues.zh: 当然，看看最近发生的事件：这些公司的自主代理进行未经请求的黑客攻击，

cues.en: that's generated a huge amount of alarm.
cues.zh: 已经引发了极大的警觉。

cues.en: Those were, in many cases, models that weren't widely available, that were, if you like, research models.
cues.zh: 在很多情况下，那些并非广泛提供的模型，或者说，是研究模型。

cues.en: So, in a sense, people in these companies do have insight into the latest that the tech can do.
cues.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，这些公司的人确实了解这项技术目前能做到什么。

cues.en: And certainly, some of the companies, particularly Anthropic, have withheld models because they're concerned about
cues.zh: 当然，其中一些公司，尤其是Anthropic，暂缓发布模型，因为他们在担心：

cues.en: You know, are we ready to deal with the risk that they might pose?
cues.zh: 也就是，我们是否准备好应对模型可能带来的风险？

cues.en: But there's also, I think, you can say that if you are in AI and you are really good at it, you are also
cues.zh: 但也可以说，如果你从事人工智能而且非常擅长，你也会是

cues.en: perhaps a true believer in its capabilities,
cues.zh: 或许是它能力的真正信仰者，

cues.en: and therefore, it's easier for you to see the potential threats, perhaps, than somebody who might be a bit more skeptical about it.
cues.zh: 因此，相比对它更怀疑的人，你可能更容易看到它潜在的威胁。

cues.en: So, I think there are two things there. Is anyone listening here, and even if they are listening, maybe in authority,
cues.zh: 所以我认为这里有两点。有人在听吗？即使有人在听，可能还是有权力的人，

cues.en: is there anything they can do about it? Because this is a global technology.
cues.zh: 他们能对此做些什么吗？因为这是一项全球性的技术。

cues.en: You can't shut down one company because the clever people that are making this technology will simply go elsewhere where it is allowed.
cues.zh: 你无法关闭一家公司，因为制造这项技术的聪明人只会转去允许这样做的其他地方。

cues.en: Well, I think the last point is absolutely critical. I mean, there is a geopolitical dimension to this, isn't there?
cues.zh: 我认为最后一点绝对关键。这其中存在地缘政治层面，对吧？

cues.en: I mean, you know, weapons are terrible things, but if the other guy's got them, we want them too.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，武器是可怕的东西，但如果对方拥有武器，我们也想要。

cues.en: And I think, you know, that was the logic of nuclear armament, and there is a sort of certain amount of that similar sort of geopolitics here.
cues.zh: 我认为，你知道，这就是核军备的逻辑，而这里也存在某种类似的地缘政治。

cues.en: You know, AI brings lots of useful things.
cues.zh: 你知道，人工智能带来了许多有用的东西。

cues.en: And reining it in, if the other side isn't going to do it,
cues.zh: 但如果另一方不这样做，要限制它，

cues.en: it's difficult for individual nations to do that without feeling they're putting themselves at risk.
cues.zh: 各国很难在不觉得自己将自身置于风险之中的情况下做到这一点。

cues.en: On the face of it, a multilateral agreement is what's required,
cues.zh: 表面看来，需要的是一项多边协议，

cues.en: but, you know, there's a difficult logic to that.
cues.zh: 但你知道，这其中存在着难以处理的逻辑。

cues.en: Chris Vallance.
cues.zh: 克里斯·瓦兰斯。

cues.en: The British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has defended his government's decision to impose sanctions on goods
cues.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆为其政府决定制裁相关商品进行辩护，

cues.en: from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
cues.zh: 这些商品来自被占领的约旦河西岸以色列定居点。

cues.en: The UK's announcement came after Israel opened up tenders for the construction of some 1,200 Jewish settlement homes.
cues.zh: 英国的公告是在以色列为建造约1200套犹太人定居点住房招标后发布的。

cues.en: continuing its expansion into a strategically important area east of Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 这意味着其继续向耶路撒冷以东的战略要地扩张。

cues.en: It's been clear for some time that the possibility of a two-state solution for Palestinians and Israelis is receding rapidly.
cues.zh: 一段时间以来很明显，巴勒斯坦人与以色列人的两国方案正迅速变得遥不可及。

cues.en: The plans have drawn widespread international condemnation.
cues.zh: 这些计划遭到国际社会的广泛谴责。

cues.en: Eleven other countries echoed London's announcement that they will, or already have, imposed their own restrictions.
cues.zh: 另有11个国家响应伦敦的公告，表示将或已经实施各自的限制措施。

cues.en: Speaking at Prime Minister's Question Time in the British Parliament, Mr Burnham said the UK was providing leadership on a world stage
cues.zh: 伯纳姆在英国议会的首相质询时间说，英国正在世界舞台上发挥领导作用，

cues.en: by taking action in the face of injustice.
cues.zh: 通过在面对不公时采取行动。

cues.en: In this difficult and dangerous world, Britain has to stand for something.
cues.zh: 在这个艰难而危险的世界，英国必须代表一些价值。

cues.en: Britain has to show leadership. Britain has to stand for fairness against injustice.
cues.zh: 英国必须展现领导力，必须代表公平、反对不公。

cues.en: Where people are being bullied out of their homes, intimidated, we will always stand with the underdog and take what action we can to support them.
cues.zh: 人们被赶出家园、受到恐吓时，我们总会支持弱者，并采取力所能及的行动帮助他们。

cues.en: That, Mr Speaker, is leadership on the world stage, Britain being true to what it's always been about.
cues.zh: 议长先生，这就是在世界舞台上的领导力，英国忠于一贯的立场。

cues.en: That is what the British people expect of us, and that is what this government will do.
cues.zh: 这正是英国人民对我们的期望，也是本届政府将要做的事。

cues.en: Meanwhile, the Israeli authorities are taking further action against countries which have imposed sanctions.
cues.zh: 与此同时，以色列当局正对实施制裁的国家采取进一步行动。

cues.en: They're recommending that representatives from a number of charities, including Oxfam and Save the Children, are denied entry to Israel.
cues.zh: 他们建议拒绝一些慈善机构的代表入境以色列，其中包括乐施会和救助儿童会。

cues.en: Israel hasn't yet announced what steps it's taking against Canada and France
cues.zh: 以色列尚未宣布将对加拿大和法国采取什么措施，

cues.en: which joined Britain in declaring a ban on trade with Jewish West Bank settlements.
cues.zh: 这两国加入英国，宣布禁止与约旦河西岸犹太人定居点进行贸易。

cues.en: So what response has there been within Israel?
cues.zh: 那么，以色列国内对此有何反应？

cues.en: I heard more from our correspondent in Jerusalem, Yolande Knell.
cues.zh: 我听取了驻耶路撒冷记者约兰德·内尔的更多报道。

cues.en: Certainly, the comments that I've seen coming out of the Israeli settlements themselves have been defiant
cues.zh: 当然，我看到以色列定居点传出的评论非常强硬，

cues.en: saying they don't care about this action
cues.zh: 称他们不在乎这项行动，

cues.en: that Israel has given the authorization for these settlements to be there and that is what the Israeli residents care about.
cues.zh: 并称以色列已批准这些定居点存在，而以色列居民关心的正是这一点。

cues.en: But there is a segment of Israeli society that does acknowledge
cues.zh: 但以色列社会中也有一部分人承认，

cues.en: that what has happened under this Israeli government is really something quite unprecedented.
cues.zh: 以色列现政府治下发生的事情确实非常前所未有。

cues.en: One hundred and four new settlements authorized in the West Bank and settler violence now at an all-time high, according to the UN.
cues.zh: 据联合国称，约旦河西岸批准了104个新定居点，定居者暴力如今达到历史最高水平。

cues.en: and that has led to this response.
cues.zh: 这促成了此次回应。

cues.en: There is one Israeli commentator writing in the newspaper Yedioth Ahronoth this morning
cues.zh: 今天早上，一位以色列评论员在《新消息报》撰文，

cues.en: saying that Jerusalem had prepared for rain, but what arrived yesterday was a full-blown storm.
cues.zh: 说耶路撒冷已经为下雨做好准备，但昨天到来的却是一场暴风雨。

cues.en: That's really referring to the fact that while Israel had prepared countermeasures to deal with what was expected
cues.zh: 这实际上是在说，以色列虽已准备好应对预期情况的反制措施，

cues.en: this announcement from the UK, it was actually a list of a dozen countries
cues.zh: 原本预期只有英国的这份公告，实际却有约12个国家，

cues.en: putting out a joint statement against settlements and trade with settlements
cues.zh: 这些国家发布联合声明，反对定居点及与定居点进行贸易，

cues.en: and Canada and France are expected to take a similar action to the UK very soon.
cues.zh: 加拿大和法国也预计很快会采取类似英国的行动。

cues.en: A spokesman for the Israeli Embassy in London blamed the announcement on UK internal politics.
cues.zh: 以色列驻伦敦大使馆发言人将公告归咎于英国国内政治。

cues.en: Has there been a reaction from the Israeli government?
cues.zh: 以色列政府有何反应？

cues.en: That is certainly something that you hear commonly from Israeli officials
cues.zh: 这确实是人们经常从以色列官员那里听到的说法，

cues.en: that they know it's going into the political party conference season in the UK, and they attribute the timing somewhat to that
cues.zh: 他们知道英国正进入政党大会季，并认为时机在一定程度上与此有关，

cues.en: and this new Labour government wanting to make its mark.
cues.zh: 也与这个新工党政府想要留下自己的印记有关。

cues.en: You also hear very commonly from Israeli officials and members of the public
cues.zh: 你也经常听到以色列官员和公众的这种看法，

cues.en: their belief that the UK is being taken over by Muslims who they say are influencing policy.
cues.zh: 他们认为英国正被穆斯林接管，并称穆斯林正在影响政策。

cues.en: That the number of immigrants who've moved to the UK is really causing these policy changes.
cues.zh: 他们认为迁往英国的移民人数确实造成了这些政策变化。

cues.en: Something that the Labour government would firmly deny.
cues.zh: 工党政府会坚决否认这一点。

cues.en: Ed Miliband, who has been speaking and making these announcements as the Foreign Secretary
cues.zh: 外交大臣埃德·米利班德一直在发表讲话并作出这些公告，

cues.en: of course, in the UK, is proudly labelling himself as a British Jew.
cues.zh: 当然，在英国，他自豪地称自己为英国犹太人。

cues.en: But at the same time as all of that, you know,
cues.zh: 但与此同时，你知道，

cues.en: Gideon Sa'ar, the Foreign Minister, has been calling this blatant interference in Israel's own election
cues.zh: 外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔一直称这是对以色列自身选举的公然干涉，

cues.en: which is due to happen in just over a month's time, six weeks' time.
cues.zh: 以色列选举将在一个多月后、约六周后举行。

cues.en: He's called this also a moral distortion.
cues.zh: 他还称这是道德扭曲。

cues.en: The Israeli media pointing out that it is unprecedented to have this closure of a consulate in Jerusalem
cues.zh: 以色列媒体指出，关闭耶路撒冷的一家领事馆是前所未有的，

cues.en: and the British one has been there since the 1830s, and it's been told now by Israeli officials
cues.zh: 英国领事馆自19世纪30年代起就在那里，而以色列官员现在已告知，

cues.en: that within 30 days it must cease its operations and that the diplomats who are working there will have their accreditation rescinded.
cues.zh: 该馆必须在30天内停止运作，在那里工作的外交官将被撤销认证。

cues.en: As you say, a harsh response. But no harsh response so far, anyway, from Israel's greatest ally, the United States.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，这是严厉的回应。但到目前为止，美国这个以色列最重要的盟友还没有严厉回应。

cues.en: How surprising is that? I think it is surprising, and it will cause real discomfort for many Israeli officials.
cues.zh: 这有多令人意外？我认为确实意外，也会让许多以色列官员真正感到不安。

cues.en: There is a report by the Israeli journalist Barak Ravid in Axios and on Israel's Channel 12
cues.zh: 以色列记者巴拉克·拉维德在Axios和以色列第12频道有一篇报道，

cues.en: saying that in that call between the British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Trump, where he spoke to him
cues.zh: 称英国首相安迪·伯纳姆与特朗普总统通话时，伯纳姆曾与他交谈，

cues.en: ahead of the British announcement, that it was made clear that there would be a British move to ban settlement goods
cues.zh: 在英国公告发布前，英方已明确将采取行动禁止定居点商品，

cues.en: and that President Trump did not oppose that. Yolande Knell.
cues.zh: 而特朗普总统并不反对这一行动。约兰德·内尔。

cues.en: The recent killing of eight women in Cameroon over the course of a week
cues.zh: 过去一周，喀麦隆有八名女性遇害，

cues.en: has sparked outrage and renewed calls for specific legislation against gender-based violence.
cues.zh: 这引发了愤怒，也再次促使人们呼吁制定专门法律，打击性别暴力。

cues.en: Official figures show that at least 250 women were killed between 2023 and the first four months of this year.
cues.zh: 官方数据显示，2023年至今年前四个月，至少有250名女性遇害。

cues.en: Civil society organisations say the country is facing a crisis of femicide
cues.zh: 民间社会组织称，该国正面临杀害女性的危机，

cues.en: and that these figures may be even higher as some cases go unreported.
cues.zh: 而且由于一些案件未被报告，实际数字可能更高。

cues.en: Our reporter Paul Njie has been speaking with families of femicide victims
cues.zh: 我们的记者保罗·恩杰一直在采访杀害女性受害者的家属，

cues.en: as well as survivors of gender-based violence in the capital, Yaoundé.
cues.zh: 以及首都雅温得的性别暴力幸存者。

cues.en: And a warning: some details in this report are distressing.
cues.zh: 提醒一下：本报道中的一些细节令人痛苦。

cues.en: Panic and dismay following the discovery of a lifeless woman at a hotel in Yaoundé.
cues.zh: 在雅温得一家酒店发现一名女子死亡后，人们陷入恐慌和悲痛。

cues.en: Forty-four-year-old Crescence was stabbed to death by a man, prompting widespread outcry against the wanton killing of women across the country.
cues.zh: 44岁的克雷桑丝被一名男子刺死，引发全国对肆意杀害女性的广泛抗议。

cues.en: At her family residence, her father still grapples with the shock of her loss.
cues.zh: 在她的家中，她的父亲仍在努力面对失去女儿的震惊。

cues.en: I wanted Crescence to be here because, as she was the eldest in a family of nine children.
cues.zh: 我希望克雷桑丝能在这里，因为她是九个孩子中最大的。

cues.en: I wanted her to be the guide of the family after me.
cues.zh: 我希望在我之后由她来引领这个家庭。

cues.en: More than four and a half years ago, they lost their mother, and Crescence was the one who had to replace her.
cues.zh: 四年半多以前，他们失去了母亲，而克雷桑丝不得不接替母亲的位置。

cues.en: Officials say at least 50 women were killed in the first four months of this year alone.
cues.zh: 官员称，仅今年前四个月就有至少50名女性遇害。

cues.en: Crescence was just one of at least eight others to be killed in a week in August.
cues.zh: 克雷桑丝只是8月一周内至少8名遇害女性中的一人。

cues.en: Some women are lucky to survive gender-based violence, but the trauma, stigma, and pain are indelible, especially for those in abusive marriages.
cues.zh: 一些女性幸运地挺过了性别暴力，但创伤、污名和痛苦无法磨灭，尤其是身处虐待婚姻的人。

cues.en: That's the case of Grace, who left her marriage of two decades after being physically abused by her husband.
cues.zh: 格蕾丝就是这样的人；她在遭受丈夫身体虐待后，离开了长达20年的婚姻。

cues.en: We've changed her name to protect her identity.
cues.zh: 我们更改了她的名字，以保护她的身份。

cues.en: Women who are victims of domestic violence in Cameroon are not protected.
cues.zh: 在喀麦隆，家庭暴力受害女性得不到保护。

cues.en: There's no real structure in place because when you complain
cues.zh: 因为当你投诉时，这里没有真正的救助机制，

cues.en: people ask you, "Why did he beat you?"
cues.zh: 人们会问你：“他为什么打你？”

cues.en: When you say he beat you while you were asleep, nobody believes you.
cues.zh: 当你说他在你睡着时打你，却没人相信你。

cues.en: You arrive and find women like yourself who are supposed to welcome you, but they are the very women who tell you
cues.zh: 你来到这里，发现一些和你一样的女性本应欢迎你，但她们却告诉你，

cues.en: I'm sure it was your neighbour who advised you to file a complaint against your husband.
cues.zh: “我敢肯定，是你的邻居劝你投诉丈夫的。”

cues.en: Is she divorced?
cues.zh: 她离婚了吗？

cues.en: I put these concerns to the Minister of Women's Empowerment and the Family, Professor Marie-Thérèse Abena Ondoa,
cues.zh: 我向妇女赋权与家庭事务部长玛丽-泰蕾丝·阿贝娜·翁多阿教授提出了这些问题，

cues.en: but she denied claims that the government was not doing enough to protect women and prevent gender-based violence.
cues.zh: 但她否认政府在保护女性、预防性别暴力方面做得不够。

cues.en: She said a bill to that effect is currently being reviewed at the Prime Minister's office.
cues.zh: 她说，相关法案目前正在总理办公室审议。

cues.en: We have reached a consensus on the formulation of the different articles and what have you.
cues.zh: 我们已就各项条文的制定等内容达成共识。

cues.en: And I don't think the Prime Minister's services have been sleeping on it, no.
cues.zh: 我不认为总理办公室对此一直无所作为，不是的。

cues.en: And my hope, and I don't think I'm wrong,
cues.zh: 我的希望是，而且我认为我没有说错，

cues.en: is that that bill will probably reach Parliament in the November session.
cues.zh: 那项法案很可能会在11月会期提交议会。

cues.en: But the said bill has already been in the works for several years now
cues.zh: 但这项法案其实已经酝酿了好几年，

cues.en: and because the November session of Parliament is mostly dominated by debates on the budget
cues.zh: 而且由于议会11月会期主要被预算辩论占据，

cues.en: civil society activists are skeptical that anything concrete will emerge from there.
cues.zh: 民间社会活动人士怀疑那里能否取得任何实质成果。

cues.en: In the meantime, families who've lost loved ones to the brutality of femicide will keep hoping for justice to take its course.
cues.zh: 与此同时，那些因杀害女性的暴行而失去亲人的家庭，将继续等待正义得到伸张。

cues.en: Paul Njie.
cues.zh: 保罗·恩杰。

cues.en: To Norway now, where funeral ceremonies for King Harald V have taken place.
cues.zh: 现在转到挪威，哈拉尔五世国王的葬礼已经举行。

cues.en: As thousands of people crowded the streets, the Norwegian Royal Family led the funeral procession, with members of the military joining in the march.
cues.zh: 成千上万的人挤满街道，挪威王室带领送葬队伍，军方成员也加入行列。

cues.en: King Harald died at the age of 89 after 35 years on the throne.
cues.zh: 哈拉尔国王在位35年后，于89岁时去世。

cues.en: His son, Haakon VIII, has succeeded him.
cues.zh: 他的儿子哈康八世继承了王位。

cues.en: Members of the British Royal Family, including the Prince of Wales and Princess Anne, attended the service
cues.zh: 英国王室成员，包括威尔士亲王和安妮公主，出席了仪式，

cues.en: alongside members of the Danish, Swedish, and Dutch royal families.
cues.zh: 丹麦、瑞典和荷兰王室成员也参加了仪式。

cues.en: Our Global Affairs Reporter Mimi Swaby has been following the ceremony. She told me more about the day's events.
cues.zh: 我们的全球事务记者米米·斯瓦比一直在跟进仪式。她向我介绍了当天的更多情况。

cues.en: So after a procession carrying King Harald's coffin from the Royal Palace to Oslo Cathedral,
cues.zh: 运载哈拉尔国王棺柩的队伍从王宫前往奥斯陆大教堂后，

cues.en: there was a ceremony, a very moving ceremony, for an hour it lasted.
cues.zh: 举行了一场持续一小时、感人至深的仪式。

cues.en: That started with a minute of silence, which was held nationwide, and then memorial speeches took place.
cues.zh: 仪式以全国范围的一分钟默哀开始，随后举行了追悼演讲。

cues.en: Now, some speeches were from the President of Parliament, who said that King Harald wasn't afraid to meet people with his wellies on
cues.zh: 一些演讲由议会议长发表。他说，哈拉尔国王不怕穿着雨靴与民众见面，

cues.en: referring to times where this symbol of unity went to victims of attacks or went to times or places where people needed him most.
cues.zh: 指的是这位团结的象征曾去看望袭击受害者，或前往人们最需要他的时刻和地方。

cues.en: He was seen as a symbol of unity and stability during times of upheaval.
cues.zh: 在动荡时期，他被视为团结与稳定的象征。

cues.en: He then went on to say that the king lived up to his slogan.
cues.zh: 他接着说，国王践行了自己的座右铭。

cues.en: That slogan is "Everything for Norway."
cues.zh: 那句座右铭是：“一切为了挪威。”

cues.en: And that is something that has been repeated throughout the 13 days of mourning now
cues.zh: 这句话在如今持续13天的哀悼期间不断被人重复，

cues.en: since the late king passed away, that he gave everything for this country, even during times of ill health.
cues.zh: 自已故国王去世以来，人们说他为这个国家奉献了一切，即使在健康不佳时也是如此。

cues.en: He refused to abdicate because he said he took the oath to be king for life.
cues.zh: 他拒绝退位，因为他说自己宣誓要终身为王。

cues.en: The ceremony concluded. It was a very touching moment when the now-widowed Queen Sonja laid a rose down on his coffin, wiping away tears.
cues.zh: 葬礼结束时，有一个十分感人的时刻：如今成为寡妇的宋雅王后把一朵玫瑰放在他的棺木上，拭去眼泪。

cues.en: Immediate family members were very close to the coffin, but the cathedral was full.
cues.zh: 直系家人都站在棺木旁，但大教堂里座无虚席。

cues.en: It normally has a capacity of about 800, but it was extended to more than a thousand to mark this very special occasion.
cues.zh: 大教堂通常可容纳约800人，但为纪念这一特殊时刻，容量扩大到一千多人。

cues.en: The first state funeral since 1991.
cues.zh: 这是自1991年以来的首次国葬。

cues.en: So, a very grand occasion, filled with mourning and a lot of sorrow, but also a celebration of a king who was incredibly popular among Norwegians.
cues.zh: 这是一场盛大的仪式，充满哀悼和悲伤，也是对一位深受挪威人欢迎的国王的庆祝。

cues.en: His coffin is now going to go to the Akershus Fortress, where he will finally be laid to rest.
cues.zh: 他的棺木现在将被送往阿克什胡斯要塞，他最终将在那里安葬。

cues.en: A private ceremony will be held for close family members and other close guests.
cues.zh: 随后将为近亲和其他亲近的宾客举行私人仪式。

cues.en: Before later this afternoon, we can expect the new king, his son, King Haakon VIII, to address the public from the palace balcony.
cues.zh: 今天下午晚些时候，新国王、他的儿子哈康八世预计将在王宫阳台向公众讲话。

cues.en: So, a long day filled with ceremony and tradition and a lot of security as well, as this is a massive event in Oslo.
cues.zh: 这是漫长的一天，充满仪式、传统和大量安保，因为这是奥斯陆的一场大型活动。

cues.en: There has been some controversy around Norway's royal family in recent years. Will it be as popular without him?
cues.zh: 近年来，挪威王室一直存在一些争议。没有他之后，王室还会同样受欢迎吗？

cues.en: The late King, King Harald, was incredibly popular, so the new King, King Haakon, has big shoes to fill, essentially.
cues.zh: 已故的哈拉尔国王极受欢迎，所以新国王哈康要接替他，确实任重道远。

cues.en: The new king has some scandals among his intimate family. His wife—it was revealed earlier this year—had ties
cues.zh: 新国王的亲近家人中有一些丑闻。他的妻子——今年早些时候被披露——与

cues.en: to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
cues.zh: 已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦有关系。

cues.en: Something she came out to apologize for, saying she wished she never met him.
cues.zh: 她为此出面道歉，称自己希望从未见过他。

cues.en: And his stepson, Marius Borg Høiby, he's been convicted of two counts of rape, alongside other sexual-offence charges.
cues.zh: 而他的继子马里乌斯·博格·霍伊比，他已被判两项强奸罪，另有其他性犯罪指控。

cues.en: He has been given temporary leave today to come to the funeral, but these are scandals which will be plaguing the royal family and something
cues.zh: 他今天获准暂时离开拘押地参加葬礼，但这些丑闻会困扰王室，并且是

cues.en: he'll have to win public trust back with.
cues.zh: 他必须就这些事情重新赢回公众信任。

cues.en: Mimi Swaby.
cues.zh: 米米·斯瓦比报道。

cues.en: Still to come: repeated heat damage to the lining of the oesophagus.
cues.zh: 本期播客稍后还将讨论：反复的高温会损伤食管内壁。

cues.en: Really hot liquids could possibly injure the cells of the lining, which might make the tissue more vulnerable, and these processes could eventually lead to cancer.
cues.zh: 非常热的液体可能损伤内壁细胞，使组织更脆弱，而这些过程最终可能导致癌症。

cues.en: Scientists say drinking very hot tea or coffee could significantly increase the risk of oesophageal cancer.
cues.zh: 科学家说，喝很烫的茶或咖啡可能显著增加患食管癌的风险。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《Global News Podcast》。

cues.en: Next to the story of the first Afghan woman to climb Mount Everest.
cues.zh: 接下来是首位攀登珠穆朗玛峰的阿富汗女性的故事。

cues.en: As a teenager in Afghanistan, River Ahmad survived a Taliban attack on her bus by pretending to be dead.
cues.zh: 十几岁时，里弗·艾哈迈德在阿富汗遭遇塔利班袭击，她装死而躲过了对巴士的攻击。

cues.en: She dreamed of climbing Everest with her 20-year-old brother, who later killed himself.
cues.zh: 她梦想和20岁的弟弟一起攀登珠峰，而弟弟后来自杀身亡。

cues.en: River now lives in Australia, from where she spoke to the BBC's Sodaba Haidare about her inspiration
cues.zh: 里弗如今住在澳大利亚，她在那里接受BBC的索达巴·海达里采访，谈到自己受到的启发，

cues.en: behind reaching the top of the world's tallest mountain above sea level.
cues.zh: 以及登上这座世界上海拔最高山峰的动力。

cues.en: I just wanted to prove that Afghan women can do different things. Afghan women are not powerless,
cues.zh: 我只是想证明，阿富汗女性可以做不同的事情。阿富汗女性并非无能为力，

cues.en: as we live in the darkest part of the history.
cues.zh: 尽管我们生活在历史最黑暗的时期。

cues.en: You come from Ghazni Province. It's very mountainous.
cues.zh: 你来自加兹尼省。那里是多山地区。

cues.en: And I've read in interviews that you used to go up there with your brother.
cues.zh: 我在采访中读到过，你过去常和弟弟一起上山。

cues.en: You had a mutual dream to climb Everest together?
cues.zh: 你们曾有一起攀登珠峰的共同梦想？

cues.en: Obviously, it was very tough to go climb in Afghanistan, or specifically in a village.
cues.zh: 显然，在阿富汗，尤其是在村庄里攀登，非常困难。

cues.en: No one wanted me to climb, and the mountain was just for men and boys to go to do those kinds of things.
cues.zh: 没人希望我攀登，大家认为山是男人和男孩去做这类事情的地方。

cues.en: But I just had a very good relationship with my dad when I was very young, and I said, 'Dad, just let me climb these rocks.'
cues.zh: 但我小时候和父亲关系很好，我对他说：“爸爸，就让我爬爬这些岩石吧。”

cues.en: And when my brother grew up, we both used to go to the mountain, and we used to climb, and we used to just laugh.
cues.zh: 弟弟长大后，我们常常一起上山、攀爬，也只是一起欢笑。

cues.en: And we used to just shout on the mountain.
cues.zh: 我们还常常在山上大喊。

cues.en: You know, you can hear your reflection of your voice.
cues.zh: 你知道，你能听到自己声音的回声。

cues.en: And I was like, 'I want to climb Mount Everest!' And I was like, 'Okay, we will do that.'
cues.zh: 我当时想：“我想登上珠穆朗玛峰！”然后我又想：“好，我们会做到的。”

cues.en: I don't have my brother with me right now, and obviously I miss him all the time.
cues.zh: 现在弟弟不在我身边，显然我一直都很想念他。

cues.en: And what has been the reaction from your family, or have you had any messages from Afghan women?
cues.zh: 你的家人有什么反应？你收到过阿富汗女性的留言吗？

cues.en: Dad was not happy at all, and he sent a message to me.
cues.zh: 爸爸一点也不高兴，还给我发了消息。

cues.en: He said, "Oh, people are going to the moon."
cues.zh: 他说：“人们都要登上月球了。”

cues.en: And they are being a doctor or engineer. I don't know why you are going to Mount Everest. You're crazy.
cues.zh: 他们都要当医生或工程师。我不明白你为什么要去珠穆朗玛峰。你疯了。

cues.en: So when I climbed, the story got changed.
cues.zh: 所以，当我登上去之后，情况改变了。

cues.en: My dad immediately sent messages to me, my mom, my family, and I also got so many messages from Afghan women.
cues.zh: 爸爸马上给我、妈妈和家人发了消息，我也收到了许多阿富汗女性的留言。

cues.en: They were inspired by my climbing.
cues.zh: 她们受到了我登山经历的鼓舞。

cues.en: In 2014, you had your own experience with the Taliban, when the bus you were travelling on was attacked.
cues.zh: 2014年，你也亲身经历过塔利班袭击，当时你乘坐的巴士遭到了攻击。

cues.en: Many were killed, but you survived because you smeared period blood on your face and pretended to be dead.
cues.zh: 许多人遇害，但你在脸上抹了经血，假装自己已经死了，因此幸存下来。

cues.en: When I finished my year 12, I just wanted to go to study in Kabul.
cues.zh: 我读完12年级后，只想去喀布尔学习。

cues.en: They stopped buses along the way and just started firing guns.
cues.zh: 他们在路上拦停巴士，然后开始开枪。

cues.en: I had my period and I was like, "Oh, I'm not going to die. I love life."
cues.zh: 我当时来了月经，我就想：“哦，我不会死，我热爱生命。”

cues.en: What should I do? What should I do? And I took the blood and I put it on my face.
cues.zh: 我该怎么办？我该怎么办？于是我拿起经血，抹在脸上。

cues.en: And I just lay, pretend that I'm dead.
cues.zh: 我就躺下，假装自己死了。

cues.en: But they came to me and they just looked and said, "Oh, this prostitute lady is dead," and then left the bus.
cues.zh: 但他们走到我身边，看了看说：“这个妓女死了。”然后离开了巴士。

cues.en: What is your message to Afghan women? I want them to dream big. I want them to believe in themselves.
cues.zh: 你想对阿富汗女性说什么？我希望她们胸怀大志，相信自己。

cues.en: I know it's a very tough time, but they are stronger, stronger than they think.
cues.zh: 我知道现在非常艰难，但她们比自己想象的更坚强、更坚强。

cues.en: Everest climber, River Ahmad.
cues.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰登山者里弗·艾哈迈德。

cues.en: The US Secretary of State, Marco Rubio, has hailed Washington entering what he calls a new phase of cooperation with Colombia.
cues.zh: 美国国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥称，华盛顿正与哥伦比亚进入他所谓的合作新阶段。

cues.en: After meeting the country's new president in Bogotá.
cues.zh: 在波哥大与该国新总统会面后。

cues.en: President Abelardo de la Espriella, Colombia's new right-wing leader, said that his government wanted to be
cues.zh: 哥伦比亚新任右翼领导人、总统阿韦拉尔多·德拉埃斯普里埃利亚说，他的政府希望成为

cues.en: an ally of the US in the fight against drug trafficking.
cues.zh: 美国打击毒品走私的盟友。

cues.en: Marco Rubio will also travel to Ecuador and Peru, countries which have also seen rightward political shifts in the past few years.
cues.zh: 马尔科·鲁比奥还将前往厄瓜多尔和秘鲁，这两国近几年也出现了政治右转。

cues.en: As part of his tour of the region to countries friendly with the Trump administration.
cues.zh: 作为他访问该地区、前往亲特朗普政府国家之行的一部分。

cues.en: Anne Soy discussed his visit with Bogotá-based journalist Laura Lizarazo, the associate director at Control Risks' Global Risk Analysis Practice.
cues.zh: 安妮·索伊与驻波哥大的记者劳拉·利萨拉索讨论了此次访问。她是化险咨询全球风险分析业务的副主管。

cues.en: A global strategic intelligence and security firm.
cues.zh: 这是一家全球战略情报与安全公司。

cues.en: She began by explaining the significance of the trip.
cues.zh: 她先解释了此行的重要意义。

cues.en: Secretary Rubio's visit to Colombia is part of a broader regional visit to other countries in the Andean region.
cues.zh: 鲁比奥国务卿访问哥伦比亚，是其访问安第斯地区其他国家的更大区域之行的一部分。

cues.en: Which basically aims to advance three mutually reinforcing US objectives:
cues.zh: 这基本上旨在推进三个相互强化的美国目标：

cues.en: One, strengthening the fight against drug cartels.
cues.zh: 第一，加强打击贩毒集团。

cues.en: Two, consolidating and solidifying the US influence in the hemisphere;
cues.zh: 第二，巩固并强化美国在西半球的影响力；

cues.en: and three, building a coalition of politically aligned governments in Latin America.
cues.zh: 第三，在拉丁美洲建立政治立场一致的政府联盟。

cues.en: This visit advances those three objectives simultaneously.
cues.zh: 此次访问同时推进那三个目标。

cues.en: Why is that important for the Trump administration? You know, these renewed alignments
cues.zh: 这些重新形成的结盟，为何对特朗普政府很重要？你知道，

cues.en: within the Western Hemisphere, within the Americas, especially improving those ties?
cues.zh: 在西半球、尤其是美洲内部，改善这些关系？

cues.en: Well, that makes part of a broader goal
cues.zh: 嗯，这构成更大目标的一部分

cues.en: in US foreign policy under Trump's administration.
cues.zh: 即特朗普政府领导下的美国外交政策目标。

cues.en: Which has been labelled as the Donroe Doctrine,
cues.zh: 这被称为“唐罗主义”，

cues.en: meaning reasserting US dominance over the hemisphere as its natural region for exercising influence.
cues.zh: 意味着重新主张美国对西半球的主导权，把它视为美国施加影响的天然区域。

cues.en: And this is important for Trump, as Colombia is a longstanding partner of the US,
cues.zh: 这对特朗普很重要，因为哥伦比亚是美国的长期伙伴，

cues.en: but the relationship was strained under Gustavo Petro's government over the past four years.
cues.zh: 但过去四年两国关系在古斯塔沃·佩特罗政府时期变得紧张。

cues.en: And the visit of Secretary Rubio also aims to restore those ties
cues.zh: 此外，鲁比奥国务卿此访也旨在恢复这些关系，

cues.en: that were under tension during the past administration.
cues.zh: 它们在上一届政府时期处于紧张状态。

cues.en: How are these developments in the relationship between Washington and Bogotá
cues.zh: 华盛顿与波哥大关系的这些发展

cues.en: being received in Colombia? The country is deeply divided around that.
cues.zh: 在哥伦比亚受到怎样的反响？哥伦比亚在这个问题上严重分裂。

cues.en: And other issues, as President Abelardo de la Espriella
cues.zh: 以及其他问题；总统阿韦拉尔多·德拉埃斯普里埃利亚

cues.en: was elected by a very tight, very slim margin.
cues.zh: 以极其微弱的优势当选。

cues.en: So his mandate is relatively weak: he won by roughly 2,050 votes.
cues.zh: 因此他的授权相对薄弱：他大约只赢了2050票。

cues.en: So half the country, around half the country, the public supports and welcomes
cues.zh: 因此，全国约一半、约一半民众支持并欢迎

cues.en: a more assertive role for the US regarding security operations.
cues.zh: 美国在安全行动中发挥更积极的作用。

cues.en: As Colombian military have lost significant capabilities in terms of communications,
cues.zh: 由于哥伦比亚军队在通信方面的能力显著下降，

cues.en: logistics and mobility over the past decade.
cues.zh: 过去十年，后勤和机动能力也有所下降。

cues.en: Some people view US support, a more assertive
cues.zh: 有些人将美国的支持、更积极的

cues.en: support, as a means to bridge that gap.
cues.zh: 支持，视为弥补这一差距的办法。

cues.en: But a significant part of the population strongly opposes
cues.zh: 但相当一部分民众强烈反对

cues.en: more active participation by the US in security issues.
cues.zh: 美国更积极地参与安全事务。

cues.en: Given that that is viewed or framed as a violation of sovereignty,
cues.zh: 因为这被视为或被描述为侵犯主权，

cues.en: and that caused a strong opposition among the left and some social movements,
cues.zh: 这在左翼和一些社会运动中引发了强烈反对，

cues.en: particularly farmer and coca-crop growers who are likely to
cues.zh: 尤其是农民和古柯种植者，他们可能

cues.en: be targeted by this more heavy-handed, militaristic approach.
cues.zh: 成为这种更强硬、更军事化做法的目标。

cues.en: Laura Lizarazo from Control Risks.
cues.zh: 化险咨询的劳拉·利萨拉索。

cues.en: Now to a new study by Oxford University that says people
cues.zh: 下面来看牛津大学的一项新研究：研究称，人们

cues.en: who regularly have an extra-hot cup of tea or coffee
cues.zh: 经常喝特热茶或咖啡

cues.en: are at greater risk of developing cancer in their oesophagus.
cues.zh: 患食管癌的风险更高。

cues.en: Keren Papier is the lead researcher and nutritional epidemiologist at Oxford Population Health.
cues.zh: 凯伦·帕皮尔是牛津人口健康部门的首席研究员和营养流行病学家。

cues.en: This is a study of nearly one million UK adults, and these are free-living adults.
cues.zh: 这项研究涉及近100万名英国成年人，他们都是生活在现实环境中的成年人。

cues.en: who take part in the Million Women Study and in the UK Biobank study.
cues.zh: 他们参加了“百万女性研究”和英国生物样本库研究。

cues.en: These are people who reported how they consume their beverages and were followed up over time to see what happens for their health risk.
cues.zh: 这些人报告了自己的饮料饮用方式，研究人员随后长期跟踪，观察其健康风险变化。

cues.en: And really, what's exciting about this study is that it adds to the evidence.
cues.zh: 这项研究真正令人兴奋之处在于，它增加了相关证据。

cues.en: that drinking very hot and hot beverages could increase the risk of oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
cues.zh: 也就是说，饮用非常热和热的饮料可能增加患食管鳞状细胞癌的风险。

cues.en: We think one possible explanation could be the repeated heat damage to the lining of the oesophagus.
cues.zh: 我们认为，一种可能的解释是，食管内壁反复受到热损伤。

cues.en: So really hot liquids could possibly injure the cells of the lining, which might make the tissue more vulnerable and
cues.zh: 因此，过热的液体可能损伤内壁细胞，使组织更容易受到伤害，而

cues.en: these processes could eventually lead to cancer.
cues.zh: 这些过程最终可能导致癌症。

cues.en: And there's also a risk factor of drinking more than six drinks a day.
cues.zh: 每天饮用六杯以上也是一个风险因素。

cues.en: And I can't see from the... is that more than six hot drinks, or is it just more than six warm drinks at all?
cues.zh: 我看不出来……是六杯以上的热饮，还是总共六杯以上的温饮呢？

cues.en: That's right, we did see that even after we control for the drink temperature.
cues.zh: 没错，即使控制了饮品温度，我们仍然观察到了这一点。

cues.en: The actual frequency, the number of beverages.
cues.zh: 也就是实际饮用的频率和饮品数量。

cues.en: So we saw that drinking six or more hot drinks a day, compared to drinking less than six, was associated with a 70% higher risk.
cues.zh: 我们发现，每天饮用六杯或更多热饮，相比少于六杯，患病风险高出70%。

cues.en: Right, which sounds scary, that 70%, but actually you also make the point, because you are proper scientists.
cues.zh: 这个70%的数字听起来很吓人，但你也指出了这一点，因为你们毕竟是严谨的科学家。

cues.en: And you are looking at this, not to scare people, but to try to find out what's going on.
cues.zh: 你们研究这些不是为了吓唬人，而是为了弄清楚到底发生了什么。

cues.en: You also make the point that actually these cancers are pretty rare.
cues.zh: 你也指出，这类癌症其实相当罕见。

cues.en: And the actual risk that anyone has that is being added to is small.
cues.zh: 而且对任何人原有风险增加的实际幅度很小。

cues.en: That's right, so people in the UK have about a 1% lifetime risk of being diagnosed with this type of cancer.
cues.zh: 没错，英国人一生中被诊断出这类癌症的风险约为1%。

cues.en: And really taking things into perspective, the most important thing you can do to try to prevent cancer at all.
cues.zh: 从整体情况看，若想预防所有癌症，最重要的做法，

cues.en: And this cancer is really to stop smoking and, if possible, also to cut down on alcohol.
cues.zh: 包括预防这种癌症，确实是戒烟；如果可能，也要减少饮酒。

cues.en: But that 1% risk then increases to one point something. In other words, that 70% figure.
cues.zh: 但那1%的风险会增加到百分之一点几。换句话说，那个70%的数字——

cues.en: That sometimes is seized upon in headlines, etc. It doesn't really mean that the risk itself has increased very much.
cues.zh: 这个数字有时会被新闻标题抓住大肆渲染，但并不意味着实际风险增加了很多。

cues.en: Yes, and I suppose if people are really quite worried, because we do drink tea and coffee throughout the day.
cues.zh: 是的，如果人们真的很担心，毕竟我们一整天都会喝茶和咖啡。

cues.en: It's very popular in the UK. Just letting your cuppa cool down for a little bit would really be beneficial.
cues.zh: 这在英国很普遍。只要让你的茶水稍微凉一会儿，就会很有益。

cues.en: Keren Papier from Oxford University, talking to Justin Webb.
cues.zh: 牛津大学的凯伦·帕皮尔接受贾斯廷·韦布采访。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 我们这一期的内容就到这里。

cues.zh: 如果想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.zh: 本期由丹妮拉·巴雷拉·埃尔南德斯混音。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I am Alex Ritson. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。下次再见。
